## General Release Version 1. – Jun 2021 ## Endorsement by system Owner (internal) release history ## CONTENTS INTRODUCTION This document defines & illustrates the business requirements, process flows as well as the detailed functional requirements of the Payment module as implemented in the eCMS. This document is a detailed drill down of the high-level requirements. The payment module is one of the clearance support modules and is primarily used by Customs Broker or Importer for all the payments to be done. The payment is done in the BITS side. The generation of the payment instruction is handled in the eCMS by respective modules for e.g., declaration sends a payment instruction to the payment module for collection, accounting, and reporting. Likewise, any other module which has payment can leverage the payment module. The payment module in turn integrates with BITS and sends the payment advice to BITS for collection. ## Scope The scope of the payment module in the TFB system is as below: ## Payment Instruction Payment Registration & Approval ## Payment Configurations External Integration to Payment Gateway ## Reports and Accounting Definitions and Abbreviations ## References Payment SRS uses the following documents as reference: ## FUNCATIONAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-3.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-4.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5B.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6B.pdf ## Constraints NA ## FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS Payment Overview The payment module in the eCMS is designed flexibly to centralize all payments. This module provided a one-stop 360-degree view of all pending/completed/cancelled payment transactions of a party and update the payment status. All business modules in eCMS requiring payment will send a payment instruction to the payment module. The payment module has a common interface for payment instructions. The payment module generates the invoice and sends to BITS (Revenue System) for collection of payment. Partial payment is not supported. All payment instructions are identified by a unique payment transaction number. ## Definition of Key Terms Used in Payment Module Payment Use Cases ## Register Payment & Completed Payment Use Case Payment Backend ## Pre-Requisites BITS is ready to accept and process the payment details sent by eCMS and respond with the transaction details. ## Process Flow Figure 5: Payment Integration ## Assumptions Payment Instructions Payment Instruction is a message containing unpaid transaction information. It contains the amount to be paid along with the description and other required information. A Payment Instruction can be issued to collect full payment. Each “Payment Instruction” carries a single unpaid transaction information for which the payment has be collected. It also carries the payment amount breakdown (if applicable) for invoicing purposes and other transaction related information to easily search and correlate this payment instruction with actual transaction. The system will allow the payment for each “Payment Instruction” in Full. Each payment for a payment instruction will generate a “Payment Receipt” until it is fully paid. ## Payment Status Below shows the status transition of a Payment Instruction. Pending: It is pending in the System. ## Paid: Payment is collected in BITS and completely paid Cancelled: Payment is Cancelled. ## Payment API INTERFACES REQUIREMENTS ## System Interfaces Figure 8: System Interfaces ## Appendix Background Jobs [TABLE] SPECIFICATION for ecms - Payment Module [TABLE] document identification no 3 char SYS ID/ DOC CODE /NN/ V M.n) for details refer to document mgmt stds | document title | status (draft/ released ) | date of release | pages ECMS/srs/01/V1. | System requirements Specifications For ECMS Payment | released | 06.2021 [TABLE] role in the project | Name | signature | date (dd-mm-yy) Authors | Technical Team Reviewers | Project Lead | Sujit Patra Approver | Project Manager | Raghavan Jaganathan [TABLE] Name | designation | signature | date (dd-mm-yy) endorsed by system owner. [TABLE] S/N | Abbreviations | Description Payment Instruction | Instructions to make a payment or series of payments to a third party sent via paper and/or electronic means. Payment Transaction | Payment Transaction will capture the information about the payment like amount, description and sent by BITS Transaction Reference Number | Payment System will generate a unique transaction reference number for each transaction in a payment instruction. Business Transaction | A source for a Payment Instruction can be a business transaction between two parties. An example of business transaction in Customs system could be “submission of declaration” by importer or exporter. Invoice | A nonnegotiable commercial instrument issued by the system on behalf of the agency (Customs or Other Govt. agency) listing the payment to be made for the service rendered. Receipt | A Receipt is a written/printed acknowledgment that a payment has been received. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Generated Payment Details P02: Send Payment Details . When payment, the number will be Tax type and tax amount P03: Receive Payment Details P04: Generate Payment Advice BITS will generate the payment advice P05: Send Payment Advice Details P6: Initiate Payment The declarant will . APPENDIX 15 4.1 Configurable BLUEPRINT (CBP) 15 4.2 Print Template 16 ## INTRODUCTION This document defines & illustrates the business requirements, process flows as well as the detailed functional requirements of the Post Clearance Audit Module to be implemented for Department of Revenue and Customs Bhutan. Post clearance audit is done after the customs clearance of the goods. Post Clearance Audit is a suggested approach for Customs Control/Administrations to improve Trade Facilitation by reducing the percentage of cargo inspected during clearance. As physical inspection at the clearance point requires huge logistics, Customs Control/Administrations worldwide rely on PCA to monitor compliance and audit transactions randomly and those that are suspicious. Audit may be done in cases where there is risk involved [based on risk profile] or as a part of regular & periodic audit done on big importers who do frequent imports or authorized economic operators who have cleared goods on green/blue lane. ## Scope The scope of the Post Clearance Audit SRS covers the following topics: ## Post Clearance Compliance Auditing Create Post Clearance Audit ## Conduct Post Clearance Audit Record Audit Result ## Post Clearance Audit Closure Generate Demand Note ## Post Clearance Compliance Management Generate Audit List through Risk Checklist/Category Management. ## Definitions and abbreviations The table below lists the different acronyms and abbreviations as well as the definitions used throughout this SRS. ## References The creation of the ECMS SRS was referenced using the following documents: ## FUNCATIONAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-3.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-4.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5B.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6B.pdf ## FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS Post Clearance Compliance Auditing Overview Customs uses the Post Clearance Compliance Auditing to conduct compliance audits on the actual goods cleared against the declarations selected for audit. Post Clearance Audit process is available for all the Regime flows subject to configurations. ## Process Flow This process flow for Post Clearance Audit is shown below: ## Process Steps Auditee List The system displays all the declarations that have been flagged for Audit. Once the declaration is selected for post clearance audit, it will not appear in this list. ## Audit Case The customs officers create the audit case for a company (importer or CFA) and can select the declarations based on Customs Office, HS Code, Country of Importation etc. Once the customs officer selects the declarations the following information must be input for creating the audit case: ## Audit Start Date & End Date Audit Type ## General/Field Audit Compliance Audit ## Audit Category with Checklist Reason for Audit [predefined code table] ## Scope of Audit [predefined code table – multi-select list] Remarks for Auditee ## Remarks for Audit [Comments for auditor to note while conducting the audit] Audit Officer Assignment After audit case is submitted by the Assessor, will go through the resource assignment module to assign an audit officer. If there is no officer is available for assignment, the assessor should be able to assign an audit officer manually. ## Auditee View (In Trader Portal) The auditee company user can view the audit case in the SEW. Following information will be viewable: ## Audit Case Reference Number Company details [Name, Address & CR Number] ## Audit Type Reason for Audit Scope of Audit, & the documents needed for preparation of the Audit. List of Transaction/Declaration to be audited. ## Additional Remarks for Auditee Audit Statuses ## The following are the Audit statuses at various stages: Audit Case Print The audit officer or the company user may print the Audit Case in a PDF. The print will be made available in the summary page of the audit case. The following information will be printed in the PDF: ## Reference Case Number Company Details [Name, CRN, Address] ## Company Contact [Person & Contact] Period of Audit ## Declaration List [for Audit] Reason for Audit ## Scope of Audit Auditee Remarks ## Audit Result [with remarks] Demand Note [if any] ## Demand Note The audit officer may create a demand note (DN) after the audit and updating the audit result. The demand note is for collecting additional duties and taxes payable by the auditee due to post clearance audit outcome. The officer inputs the details of the tax types and demand note will be generated for the amount to be collected. . The auditee user may print the demand note and make payment using supported payment modes. Once the payment is made, the status of the demand note / payment instruction will be updated to “Paid”. ## POST CLEARANCE COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT Overview Customs uses the Post Clearance Compliance Management to create and manage all codes and rules required for post clearance compliance audits. ## Automated Audit List The automated audit list of declarations will be generated based on the following criteria: Risk profiles flagged for post clearance audit. For declarations assessed through green lanes, system will randomly pick declarations for post clearance audit based on a percentage configured [example 2% or 5%]. The percentage is configurable for every regime. ## Audit Category & Checklist Management The Assessor will use configuration feature module in PCA and eCMS to create, update and view categories for Audit. Categories are areas for audit for e.g. Valuation, Stocks (in case of bonded warehouse), Tariff, and Fraud etc. Based on the audit category, the Assessor can define the checklist. Checklist is a list of items to verify by the audit officer during the audit process. Once the audit is completed, the audit officer has to update the outcome for each of the check-list items. ## Post Clearance Audit Use Cases List of Use Cases ## Use Cases Diagram Use Cases for Assessor ## Use Cases for Auditor INTERFACES REQUIREMENTS ## SYSTEM INTERFACES Below diagram illustrates the interfaces integrated between Post Clearance Audit module and other modules ## Below list of services are consumed by Post Clearance Audit module: EXTERNAL INTERFACES ## NA APPENDIX ## Configurable BLUEPRINT (CBP) Print Template [TABLE] SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS SPECIFICATION for ECMS-POST routed for PCA. The list of declarations associated with the company will be shown in the detailed screen. Note : Create Audit menu will be used to create declaration records which are not routed for PCA. P02: Review Declaration From the Auditee list the Assessor will create an audit case if required for every company (importer or declarant). The customs officer will create the audit case for a company. P03: Assign Audit Once the audit case is submitted, system will create an audit case reference number. The audit case will be assigned to an audit officer automatically by the system through the resource assignment module. P04: Conduct/Record Audit The audit is conducted by the audit officer assigned to the case. The Auditor references a configurable category check list depending on the type & scope of audit. The Audit findings are updated in the system. The auditor may update the following information: Upload any scanned documents. Generate Demand Note (for additional taxes to be collected if required) Auditor can ask for declarant / importer to amend the declaration based on the post clearance audit outcome, if it is Non-Complaint. P05: Generate Demand Note/Amend the declaration If there are additional duties and taxes to be collected the officer may generate the demand note indicating the amount to be collected on the various tax types. A demand note will be generated, a notification sent to the Auditee and a payment instruction will be created in the payment module. If status be “Amend Declaration”, declarant/CFA need to amend the declaration. If status be “Compliant” it will end the audit process. P06: Payment Details of the payment instruction must be sent to the BITS revenue system. Functional Requirements 1.1 Registration System Overview 1.1.1 Entity Hierarchy in Registration 1.1.2 Customs User Hierarchy 1.1.3 Additional Design Considerations 1.2 Party Management 1.2.1 Description 1.2.2 Pre-Requisites 1.3 Login Credentials, Password Management Etc. 1.4 Fast Track TPN (BITS Integration) 1.4.1 Pre-Requisites 1.4.2 Process Flow for Fast Track TPN 1.5 Application Process 1.5.1 Pre-Requisites 1.5.2 Process Flow for Application (Generic) 1.5.3 Business Validation 1.6 Registration Process 1.7 Clearing and Forwarding Agents 1.7.1 Pre-Requisites 1.7.2 Process Flow for Clearing Agents and Forwarding Agents 1.7.3 Use Case Diagram for Clearing Agents and Forwarding Agents 1.7.4 Business Validation 1.8 Warehouse Operators 1.8.1 Pre-Requisites 1.8.2 Process Flow for Warehouse Operators 1.8.3 Use Case Diagram for Warehouse Operator Registration 1.8.4 Business Validation 1.9 Temporary Storage Operators 1.9.1 Pre-Requisites 1.9.2 Process Flow for Temporary Storage Operators (TSO) ## Use Case Diagram for Temporary Storage Operators 1.9.3 Business Validation 1.10 Declarants (CFA Employees) 1.10.1 Pre-Requisites 1.10.2 Process Flow for Declarants 1.10.3 Use Case Diagrams for Declarants. 1.10.4 Business Validation 1.11 Traders Registration 1.11.1 Pre-Requisites 1.11.2 Process Flow for Traders Registration. 1.11.3 Use Case Diagrams for Trader Registration 1.11.4 Business Validation 1.12 Customs Administrator Process 1.12.1 Customs User Registrations 1.12.2 Pre-Requisites 1.12.3 Process Flow for Customs User Registration 1.12.4 Use Case Diagram for Customs User Registration 1.12.5 Business Validation 1.13 Other Government Agency 1.13.1 Pre-Requisites 1.13.2 Process Flow for Other Government Agency User 1.13.3 Use Case Diagram for Other Government Agency 1.13.4 Business Validation 1.14 Renewal Process 1.14.1 Pre-Requisites 1.14.2 Process Flow for Renewal 1.14.3 Use Case Diagrams for Renewal 1.14.4 Business Validation ## Appendix A 1. Configuration blueprint (CBP) 2. Backend Job 3. Report Templates 4. User Interfaces 5. Inspection Checklist 6. Print Templates 7. Fees and Charges ## Introduction This document defines & illustrates the business requirements, process flows as well as the detailed functional requirements of eCMS Registration module to be implemented for Department of Revenue and Customs, Bhutan. ## Definitions and Abbreviations The table below lists the different acronyms and abbreviations as well as the definitions used throughout this SRS. ## References The creation of the BECMS SRS was referenced using the following documents: ## FUNCATIONAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-3.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-4.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5B.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6B.pdf ## Functional Requirements Registration System Overview Registration module in eCMS contains three main functionalities as listed below. Role Creation- To create roles to be used in eCMS applications. Roles are configurable and can be created as per business need. Party Creation- To create parties to be used in eCMS applications. User creation – This is to register users that are assigned to Party (for ex Customs users, OGA users, Traders, Clearing and forwarding agents, warehouse operators, temporary storage operators etc.). To perform permitted transactions in eCMS, each user of the system must belong to at least one of the parties registered in the system. The registration module uses Apache Shiro for User Authentication. The authorization (who has access to what) is controlled within the eCMS module. ## The major user groups are as below: Entity Hierarchy in Registration ## The hierarchy maintained in the eCMS Registration module is as below: Entity HIErarchy in Registration TPN is the highest level. TPN represents an entity with a unique Taxpayer number. A Party can be registered using the TPN. Each party may belong to any user group for e.g., Declarant etc. The user group is associated with the roles within the user group. User group is fixed list as it is tied to functionality in the eCMS system. The roles may be user defined and they are associated to the user groups. The privileges are controlled at the menu and function level. Registration module has implemented the generic way of managing the privileges. The function/sub-function level privileges are implemented inside the core framework. It can be easily configured at the module level. ## Customs User Hierarchy Customs User Hierarchy ## Customs user levels is defined as below: User level type maintained at National, Regional and Local users. Customs users have these fields: Regional, Customs Office (Check post) which essentially serve as the same meaning of working location. National users have access to all transactional data in eCMS; Regional user have access to transactions under their own region (includes all the check post under the regional office); local (check post) user have access to transactions under their assigned local office. Reginal and National offices are logical linkage to the customs offices. ## Additional Design Considerations Party Management ## Description In eCMS, users are assigned to a Party (for e.g., Traders, Warehouse Operator Clearing and Forwarding agents, Customs, OGA etc.). This module helps the eCMS administrator to manage the party account in eCMS by providing the appropriate web interface. To perform any transactions, each user of the system should belong to any one of the parties which is already registered in the system. ## Pre-Requisites The TPN (Taxpayer Number) Registration needs to be completed prior to the creation of Party. Trade License shall be applied separately by CFA / Warehouse/Temporary Storage Operator with the required Trade Department and this process is done outside the system. The user has the right to access eCMS application and access Party Management. ## Login Credentials, Password Management Etc. Following are the functions supported in eCMS for any user in the System. Upon successful registration, System will send an email to the user with the login credentials (Login ID and Password). User can use the provided credentials and login to eCMS. Upon first logging with System provided password, eCMS will force the user to provide a user defined password which should be as per the password policy of eCMS. As per the configured password expiry policy, user will be required to change the password periodically. User can change the password anytime from eCMS using the Change password option after logging in. In case user forgets his/her password, they can use the forget password option or request Company Admin / System admin to reset their password. After receiving new password, user must follow the same steps as laid down in Step 2 above. ## Fast Track TPN (BITS Integration) For Traders who do not have a TPN, eCMS will provide a SSP (Self Service Portal) link of BITS in the portal. Once the fast-track TPN is created in BITS, it shall be updated in eCMS PIN Master through webservice integration with BITS. In case where a CFA is declaring on behalf of an individual, with no TPN available in PIN master i.e., not registered in BITS, the system will give an option for the CFA to fast track register the importer. ## Pre-Requisites The applicant has valid ID for registering a fast-track TPN. eCMS and BITS are integrated and both services are up. ## CFA must be registered in eCMS Process Flow for Fast Track TPN ## Process ID: 02.01 – Fast Track TPN Application Process eCMS will allow unregistered Companies and users to apply for registration through an application process through a link provided in the eCMS login page. After submission of application, it shall be reviewed by Customs. Based on review outcomes if the application is approved, then, it shall be registered in eCMS. The following types of application shall be supported which are grouped as Party/Company or User based on the type of application: ## Party/Company Clearing Agents and Forwarding Agents ## Warehouse Operators Temporary Storage Operators ## Traders (EXIM) / Individual Users: These types of applicants shall be registered as users in the System once the application is approved by Customs. Following categories of application shall be registered as users upon approval: ## Declarants Company Admin (e.g., for other government agencies airlines, CFA, Warehouse operators etc.) ## Customs Other Government agencies for viewing declaration in eCMS system Customs Administrator Process: Customs administrator shall have access to all Parties and users in the Systems and can manage all users and parties. In addition, Customs Administrator can register: ## Customs Users / Customs Officers Other Government Agencies. Review and approval Process: After submission of an application, it shall be routed to the work queue of the designated Customs officer for verification by the Resource allocation module using a round-robin method. For instance, if the application needs review from a Verifier at Customs head office, then the application shall be allotted to the work queue of Verifiers. If after verification by Verifier, the application needs further review by an Assessor, then it shall be allotted to the work queue of the next available Assessor by the Resource Allocation module of the System. This shall apply to any review done by a Customs officer in this document and shall apply even if not explicitly stated in the process. Application authentication process: To ensure that the applicant is authorized to apply, system will require the applicant to provide additional field to fetch the TPN details in the application based on the Category of application. ## Pre-Requisites The Applicant is a valid citizen of Bhutan and has a valid CID and has a valid TPN. The TPN is available in eCMS through BITS integration and the TPN should be active. In case of CFA, Warehouse & Temporary storage applications, the applicant should procure the trade license and TPN from the respective departments separately (outside eCMS). In case of CFA, Warehouse applications, applicant will need to provide valid Bank guarantees. Guarantee is non-mandatory in case of Temporary storage. The applicant has the right to access eCMS application and apply for registration. ## Process Flow for Application (Generic) An external user will register with eCMS and prepare an application for Registration. ## The applicant will be required to provide either the BITS validated TPN or the importer’s CID User shall provide the CID/TPN number. The system shall allow the applicant to key in CID as well as TPN. If the applicant keys in the CID, the same should hit the Pin Master, and list all the TPN registered against the CID. If the information could not be fetched from the PIN Master, the system will provide an SSP link in the portal (outside login) the user to apply for a TPN registration with BITS. After the user applies for TPN in eCMS, BITS will validate and generate a TPN and update it back to PIN Master. Beside the link provided in e CMS for fast-track registration, after logging in into e CMS, the right is given to CFA and Customs to apply for fast-track registration on behalf of the traders. If the TPN keyed in is valid then System will fetch the related TPN details and display in the application. ## Additional functionalities Business Validation ## Registration Process The purpose of this module is to register internal users, external users like traders, clearing agent and forwarding agents, warehouse operators, temporary storage operators. A user’s role, or roles, will determine which modules they have access to. Registration is further categorized as “Party Registration” and “User Registration.” ## Additional Features for CFA/WHO and TSO The below are the list of common features that shall be supported for clearing agent and forwarding agents (CFA), warehouse operators (WHO), temporary storage operators (TSO) ## Clearing and Forwarding Agents Clearing and Forwarding Agents (CFA) are qualified and licensed to declare on behalf of any trader (Importer or Exporter) who may engage and act on their behalf. CFA engage declarants who are well versed with Customs procedure of Bhutan and have been authorized by Customs to submit declarations and other trade related documents in the System. ## Pre-Requisites The applicant for CFA should be a valid citizen of Bhutan and should have a valid CID, TPN and Trade License. BITS should be integrated with IBLS, and the CFA should have obtained a valid Trade License and TPN which should be available in eCMS PIN Master through integration with BITS. CFA has a valid Bank guarantee. The CFA has the right to access eCMS application and apply for registration. ## Process Flow for Clearing Agents and Forwarding Agents The Registration of CFA is depicted below. ## Process ID: 02.02 – Application for Clearing and Forwarding Agents Use Case Diagram for Clearing Agents and Forwarding Agents Note: A clearing agent should be allowed to declare from any region regardless of where they are registered. ## Business Validation Warehouse Operators Warehouse operators will provide storage of customs released goods in the Warehouse on a temporary basis. During the period of stay, the duties and taxes will be covered under the guarantee of the warehouse. A separate type of declaration indicating the intent of the declarant to store the goods in the warehouse shall need to be submitted in the system for entry and exit of goods from the warehouse. ## Pre-Requisites The applicant for Warehouse operator should be a valid citizen of Bhutan and should have a valid CID, TPN and Trade License. BITS should be integrated with IBLS, and the Warehouse Operator should have obtained a valid Trade License and TPN which should be available in eCMS PIN Master through integration with BITS Warehouse operator has obtained a valid Bank guarantee. The Warehouse operator has the right to access eCMS application and apply for registration. ## Process Flow for Warehouse Operators The Registration of warehouse operator in eCMS is depicted below. ## Process ID: 02.03 - Application for Warehouse Operator Use Case Diagram for Warehouse Operator Registration ## Business Validation Temporary Storage Operators Temporary storage operators (TSO) will provide temporary storage of consignments after the goods arrive at the Border. Temporary storages are provided within the border post allowing the trader a period to complete the procedure to declare and release the consignment. ## Pre-Requisites The applicant for TSO should be a valid citizen of Bhutan and should have a valid CID, TPN and Trade License. BITS should be integrated with IBLS, and the TSO should have obtained a valid Trade License and TPN which should be available in eCMS PIN Master through integration with BITS. TSO has obtained a valid Bank guarantee. The TSO has the right to access eCMS application and apply for registration. ## Process Flow for Temporary Storage Operators (TSO) The Registration of temporary storage operator in eCMS is depicted below. ## Process ID: 02.04 - Application for Temporary Storage Operator Use Case Diagram for Temporary Storage Operators ## Business Validation Declarants (CFA Employees) Declarants are individual citizen who is well versed with the Customs procedure and Customs Act of Bhutan and are certified by Customs to declare consignments in the system. A registered CFA can apply for certified Declarant to be registered with after Customs review and approval of the Declarant. The below steps detail out this process. ## Pre-Requisites The Declarant is a citizen of Bhutan and has a valid CID. The Declarant has undergone required training on Customs procedure of Bhutan and has been certified by Customs to engage in declaring consignment and other trade activities which require Custom’s intervention. The CFA intent on engaging the services of the declarant should be registered in the system with a valid CID and TPN. After initial registration with a CFA if the declarant is being engaged by another CFA, then the previous CFA should have de-registered the declarant. ## Process Flow for Declarants Process ID: 02.05 - Declarants The customs certification shall be validated before submission of the application. At the time of creating an application wherein, the system should check the applicant’s CID with the list of certified customs person in the system. ## Use Case Diagrams for Declarants. Note: Declarant are Custom certified individuals who are engaged by CFA to submit declaration on behalf of external parties. ## Additional Functionalities Note: Declarant are Custom certified individuals who are engaged by CFA for declaration submission. In this context, Declarants are different from a Trader. Warehouse Operators, TSO etc. who can also submit declarations for themselves. In case of Traders, Warehouse Operators, TSO etc., the functionality to submit declaration is provided through access configuration. ## Business Validation Traders Registration Traders are individuals and companies who are engaged in the business of importing and exporting of goods across the border of Bhutan. Traders may declare their own consignments in the system or engage CFA’s do it on their behalf. ## Pre-Requisites The applicant for trader is a citizen of Bhutan and has a valid CID/TPN ## Process Flow for Traders Registration. Process ID: 02.06 – Traders Registration ## Use Case Diagrams for Trader Registration Additional functionalities ## Business Validation Customs Administrator Process ## Following are the types of registration which shall be done by Customs Administrator: Customs User Registrations ## Customs users are employees of Bhutan Customs working in various capacities at different office locations and will use the eCMS system to facilitate processing and release of consignments from eCMS. Customs users shall be registered by Customs admin at the Head office who are expected to have the centralized list of all Customs officers working under different regional areas (RRCO) and posted at specific border location under the RRCO. Post registration of the officer in eCMS by head office, specific admin officers at the indicated RRCO shall proceed to assign roles to the registered officer. The below section details out the process of registration. ## Pre-Requisites The officer should have a valid CID and employee ID. The RRCO admin should have the right to assign different roles to the registered officer. ## Process Flow for Customs User Registration Process ID: 02.07 – Customs User Registration ## Use Case Diagram for Customs User Registration Business Validation ## Other Government Agency OGA are different Government agencies who are responsible for controlling restricted goods and providing permits and license and can register themselves in eCMS by providing registration details (outside the system) to Customs admin. Customs admin shall register the OGA and create an admin user for the registered OGA. The below section details out the process of registration. ## Pre-Requisites OGA seeking registration should have provided required details to Customs. OGA should provide the details of the user who shall be the admin for the OGA. Customs Admin registering the OGA should be familiar with the roles which need to be assigned to the OGA. ## Process Flow for Other Government Agency User Process ID: 02.08 – Other Government Agency User ## Use Case Diagram for Other Government Agency Business Validation ## Renewal Process Certain parties like Clearing agents and Warehouse operators, the license to operate is provided for a certain period and the license needs to be renewed before the expiry of the license. Below is the process flow for renewal of license and is a generic flow which covers both Clearing and Forwarding agents and Warehouse Operator. ## Pre-Requisites Party should be registered in the System with a valid license due to expire. Party admin should have access to renewal CFA/BHW functionality in eCMS. ## Process Flow for Renewal Use Case Diagrams for Renewal ## Business Validation Appendix A ## Configuration blueprint (CBP) Configuration Blueprint (CBP) for Application and Registration ## Backend Job System will check through a batch job if the TPN has been cancelled in PIN Master then matching parties shall be de-registered in eCMS. eCMS Update: eCMS will be updated with the review outcomes (Approval or Rejection) by a Batch job and Party shall be updated appropriately to reflect the review decisions. ## Report Templates Please check Reports SRS ## User Interfaces Refer to Prototype. Note: Though we released the prototype, actual UI implementation look, and feel may vary based on SmartGWT framework. ## Inspection Checklist Verifier can fill in the Inspection checklist in the Inspection tab as per the provided Checklist below for WHO and TSO. ## Print Templates CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION TO ACT AS CUSTOMS CLEARING AGENT ## CERTIFICATE OF APPROVAL OF A PLACE FOR LOADING / UNLOADING / TEMPORARY STORAGE CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION FOR PUBLIC OR PRIVATE WAREHOUSE ## Fees and Charges Provided below are the list of all applicable Fees and charges for reference. P04: Register TPN in eCMS eCMS will receive the fast-track TPN from BITS and will proceed to register it in PIN Master as a regular TPN. TPN details will have to be updated in PIN master as and when new TPN are registered in BITS [TABLE] CATEGORY | VALIDATION FIELD Individual | CID Number Business | Business License Number Company | Company Registration Number [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application User will submit online application form by providing mandatory information based on the type of application. Upon submission, the status of the Application shall be “Pending Review”. P02: Review Application Customs will review the application details submitted by the Applicant. Based on the type of application, different branch of Customs may be involved in the application review process. The Application shall be routed to the work queue of the designated officer in a round-robin method which shall be handled by Resource Allocation module. P03: Register in eCMS If the application is determined to be acceptable by Customs, then Customs shall approve the application. The Status of the application shall be set to “Approved” and System will then proceed to register a Party or User in eCMS based on the details provided in the application. If the application is determined to be un-acceptable, then Customs will reject the application and, in this case, the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. P04: Rejection of application If the application is determined to be un-acceptable, then Customs can either: 1. Reject it for amendment: In this case, applicant will need to required amendment in the application and re-submit for review by Customs 2. Reject the application: In this case, officer shall provide remarks for rejection and reject the application. The status of the application shall be “Rejected”, and no further actions are possible on the application. Hence applicate must submit new application for the customs processing. [TABLE] S/N | Additional Features Applicant can track the status of the application through a portlet. The status can be checked based on the TPN, CID and Application reference number. There shall be portlet for Registration / Application (For CFA, Warehouse, TSO and Traders). There will be no DRAFT status for application submission since this will happen without login. The application must be submitted and there will not be a Save option. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules The applicant should have a valid CID and TPN which is available in eCMS. Only one application per TPN shall be allowed in the System. Once an application has been submitted, applicant cannot make any changes to the application unless customs have redirected it back for amendment. The amendment cannot be made in the company profile details. The system should automatically deregister (CFA/WHO/TSO) who has cancelled the trade license and the TPN has become invalid in BITS. BITS system will send updates to eCMS when there are changes in BITS system, based that eCMS will update as de-registered in the PIN master and batch job will be executed to apply same changes in party table accordingly. The system should not allow the applicant to edit the profile details retrieved from BITS before submission of the application too [TABLE] S/N | Additional Features User will enter CID and retrieve list of TPNs. Upon selection of TPN, System will need user to provide the Business License number for authentication. System will verify that the provided Business license belongs to the selected TPN and, if it matches, then proceed to load the TPN details (including license number) from the PIN master. System to provide an option for the applicant to choose the bank who issued the bank guarantee The Assessor must be able to check all TPN’s to which a CID number is associated. Note: Separate screen will be provided to officer to verify and decide based on their business need. If any fees are applicable, System shall collect the fees before issuing the Certificate of Registration. System shall send the payment details to Revenue system after approval of the Registration (CFA, Warehouse Operator, TSO). Post completion of payment and receipt of response from Revenue System, system will allow printing of Certificate mentioned. Applicable fees are included in the appendix section. The following certificates along with validity are mentioned below. For CFA: A “Certificate of Registration to Act as a Clearing Agent” will be issued, which will be valid for three (3) years. (Configurable) For Warehouse Operator: A “Certificate of Registration for Public or Private Warehouse / Airline Store / Duty Free Shop” will be issued, which will be valid for two (2) years. (Configurable). For TSO: A “Certificate of Registration for Temporary Storage Operator” will be issued, which will be valid for two (2) years. (Configurable) Applicant can take a print of this certificate after logging into eCMS provided all due payment (if applicable) are cleared The CFA/BWH/TSO must also agree to an agreement with DRC and agree to the terms and conditions before the certificate can be issued. This will be provided as a standard term of agreement in the application and applicant will need to agree to the terms and conditions of this agreement before submission. (The applicant shall be informed in the application that the agreement is applicable only when the registration is approved by customs) CFAs/WHO/TSO must be able to renew their registration after three (3) years. When a CFA/WHO/TSO has been registered, they must be sent automatic reminders to renew their application three (3) months, two (2) months and one (1) before the end of their certificate’s validity period. These reminders must be configurable through the System Administration module. At any point in time, Customs must be able to cancel a registration. During Cancellation, System will check if TPN is cancelled in PIN Master. If it is cancelled, then the registration will be cancelled in eCMS. If not, it will be De-registered. In all cases, CFA/WHO/TSO cannot access the system once Customs cancels the registration. System will also run a batch job to check for Cancelled TPN in the PIN Master and cancel matching party in eCMS. Warehouse and Temporary Storage operators can submit declaration for themselves, and the required privileges can be provided in the system. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application An applicant will submit online application form by providing mandatory information including TPN & CID and Business License number. The system shall allow the applicant to key in CID, TPN and Business License number. If the applicant keys in the CID, the same will hit the Pin Master, and list all the TPN registered against the CID. If the TPN and Business License number keyed in is valid and matching, then System will fetch the related TPN details and display in the application If the information could not be fetched from the Pin Master, the system will provide a link for the user to apply for a fast-track TPN with BITS. After the user applies for fast-track TPN in eCMS, BITS will validate and generate a fast-track TPN and update it back to PIN Master. Refer to Fast-Track TPN process. Based on the entered value eCMS must retrieve required details (including Trader License Number) from PIN master and populate in the application. Applicant will provide Bank Guarantee details along with Reference number. Applicant will provide Bank Guarantee supporting documents. Applicant shall accept the agreement with DRC and agree to the terms and conditions (however inform the applicant on the application of the agreement only when the registration is approved by customs) In case of any missed information, System will stop the submission with proper validation message. Upon submission, the status of the Application shall be “Pending Review”. P02: Check supporting documents. Post submission System will route the application to be reviewed by the Verifier. The verifier will verify the supporting document details along with TPN and Trade License information. The verifier will verify the applicant details and determine the validity of the application. eCMS will additionally provide a separate tab to enter checklist of items for the verifier to mark and check. Verifier can also attach supporting documents in a separate tab on the outcome of onsite verification (for ex, Site photographs etc.) P03: Check Bank Guarantee Verifier will determine the validity and suitability of the provided bank guarantee by the applicate. P04: Notify Applicant of Rejection During verification, if the verifier concludes that the application is invalid for any reason, then the verifier will provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. The applicant shall be notified of the rejection including the reason for rejection by email. In this case the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. In case the application needs to be amended by the applicant, the verifier can “Reject for amendment” and in this case, the applicant can do necessary changes and re-submit for verification. P05: Recommend for Registration During verification, the verifier finds all provided details are in order, then the verifier can recommend the applicant for Registration as a CFA. In this case System will route the application for review from an Assessor at the Customs Head Officer. If assessor decides to reject the application, then assessor shall provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. System shall notify the applicant on the rejection by email including the reasons of rejection and the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. P06: Register CFA During verification, if the Assessor concludes that the provided documents and related details are in order, then the Assessor can approve the application for Registration. In this case, System will register the applicant as a CFA in eCMS. In case fees are applicable and payment is due, the status of the application shall be “Pending Payment”. In case fees are not applicable, the status of the application shall be “Approved”, P07: Send Confirmation Post registration, System will notify the applicant on the successful registration as CFA. If no payments are applicable, then system will send the login credentials and no further processing are required. If payment is applicable, then the applicant shall be notified on the successful completion of review and pending payment status. No login credentials shall be sent in this case. P08: Generate Payment advice Post approval and registration, system will determine if fees are applicable based on configuration. If no fees are applicable, system will allow printing of certificate of registration. If fees are applicable, a payment advice shall be generated and sent to Revenue and kept CFA as “pending payment”. Registration certificate printing and login access shall be withheld till all payments are completed. P09: Send to Revenue System eCMS will integrate with Revenue system and send the payment advice generated in previous step. P10: Receive payment confirmation from Revenue System Revenue system will send the payment advice to e CMS, wherein the applicant will be able to view the same. the applicant should be given an interface that will be integrated to the BITS payment from e CMS. Upon payment confirmation from BITS, the system will generate a certificate of Registration. After receipt of collection message, eCMS will enable printing of Registration certificate and login access will be restored. P11: Send Login Credentials System will send the login credentials to the applicant. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules Applicant for CFA should have a valid CID, TPN and Trade License. A bank guarantee needs to be furnished which is mandatory. However, System will not validate on the authenticity of the bank Guarantee. Applicant needs to provide a valid TPN, and system will check for its validity against the PIN Master. Please note that BITS will integrate with eCMS and share Trade license information along with TPN to eCMS. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application An applicant will submit online application form by providing mandatory information including TPN &CID and Business License number. The system shall allow the applicant to key in CID, TPN and Business License number. If the applicant keys in the CID, the same should hit the Pin Master, and list all the TPN registered against the CID. If the TPN and Business License number keyed in is valid and matching, then System will fetch the related TPN details and display in the application If the information could not be fetched from the Pin Master, the system will provide an option for the user to apply for a fast-track TPN with BITS. After the user applies for fast-track TPN in eCMS, BITS will validate and generate a fast-track TPN and update it back to PIN Master. Refer to Fast-Track TPN process. Based on the entered value eCMS must retrieve required details (including Trader License Number) from PIN master and populate in the application. Applicant will provide Bank Guarantee details along with Reference number. Applicant will provide Bank Guarantee supporting documents. Applicant shall accept the agreement with DRC and agree to the terms and conditions (however inform the applicant on the application of the agreement only when the registration is approved by customs) In case of any missed information, System will stop the submission with proper validation message. Upon submission, the status of the Application shall be “Pending Review”. P02: Check supporting documents. Post submission System will route the application to be reviewed by the Verifier. The verifier will verify the supporting document details along with TPN and Trade License information. The verifier will verify the applicant details and determine the validity of the application. eCMS will additionally provide a separate tab to enter checklist of items for the verifier to mark and check. Verifier can also attach supporting documents in a separate tab on the outcome of onsite verification (for ex, Site photographs etc.). P03: Check Bank Guarantee Verifier will determine the validity and suitability of the provided bank guarantee by the applicate. P04: Notify Applicant of Rejection During verification, if the verifier concludes that the application is invalid for any reason, then the verifier will provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. The applicant shall be notified of the rejection including the reason for rejection by email. In this case the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. In case the application needs to be amended by the applicant, the verifier can “Reject for amendment” and in this case, the applicant can do necessary changes and re-submit for verification. P05: Recommend for Registration During verification, the verifier finds all provided details are in order, then the verifier can recommend the applicant for Registration as a Warehouse Operator. In this case System will route the application for review from an Assessor at the Customs Head Officer. If assessor decides to reject the application, then assessor shall provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. System shall notify the applicant on the rejection by email including the reasons of rejection and the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. P06: Register Warehouse Operator During verification, if the Assessor concludes that the provided documents and related details are in order, then the Assessor can approve the application for Registration. In this case, System will register the applicant as a Warehouse Operator in eCMS. In case fees are applicable and payment is due, the status of the application shall be “Pending Payment”. In case fees are not applicable, the status of the application shall be “Approved”, P07: Send Confirmation Post registration, System will notify the applicant on the successful registration as Warehouse Operator. If no payments are applicable, then system will send the login credentials and no further processing are required. If payment is applicable, then the applicant shall be notified on the successful completion of review and pending payment status. No login credentials shall be sent in this case. P08: Generate Payment advice Post approval and registration, system will determine if fees are applicable based on configuration. If no fees are applicable, system will allow printing of certificate of registration. If fees are applicable, a payment advice shall be generated and sent to Revenue. Registration certificate printing and login access shall be withheld till all payments are completed. P09: Send to Revenue System eCMS will integrate with Revenue system and send the payment advice generated in previous step. P10: Receive payment confirmation from Revenue System Revenue system will send a payment confirmation to eCMS after collecting payment in Revenue system. After receipt of collection message, eCMS will enable printing of Registration certificate and login access will be restored. P11: Send Login Credentials System will send the login credentials to the applicant. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules The applicant for Warehouse operator should have a valid CID, TPN and Trade License/ A bank guarantee needs to be furnished. However, System will not validate on the authenticity of the bank Guarantee, and this shall be verified by the respective officer. Applicant needs to provide a valid TPN, and system will check for its validity against the PIN Master. Please note that BITS will integrate with eCMS and share Trade license information along with TPN to eCMS. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application An applicant will submit online application form by providing mandatory information including TPN, CID and Business License number. The system shall allow the applicant to key in CID, TPN and Business License number. If the applicant keys in the CID, the same should hit the Pin Master, and list all the TPN registered against the CID. If the TPN and Business License number keyed in is valid and matching, then System will fetch the related TPN details and display in the application If the information could not be fetched from the Pin Master, the system will provide an option for the user to apply for a fast-track TPN with BITS. After the user applies for fast-track TPN in eCMS, BITS will validate and generate a fast-track TPN and update it back to PIN Master. Refer to Fast-Track TPN process. Based on the entered value eCMS must retrieve required details (including Trader License Number) from PIN master and populate in the application. Applicant will provide Bank Guarantee details along with Reference number (non-Mandatory in case of TSO). Applicant will provide Bank Guarantee supporting documents (non-Mandatory in case of TSO). Applicant shall accept the agreement with DRC and agree to the terms and conditions (however inform the applicant on the application of the agreement only when the registration is approved by customs) In case of any missed information, System will stop the submission with proper validation message. Upon submission, the status of the Application shall be “Pending Review”. P02: Check supporting documents. Post submission System will route the application to be reviewed by the Verifier. The verifier will verify the supporting document details along with TPN and Trade License information. The verifier will verify the applicant details and determine the validity of the application. eCMS will additionally provide a separate tab to enter checklist of items for the verifier to mark and check. Verifier can also attach supporting documents in a separate tab on the outcome of onsite verification (for ex, Site photographs etc.). P03: Check Bank Guarantee Verifier will determine the validity and suitability of the provided bank guarantee. P04: Notify Applicant of Rejection During verification, if the verifier concludes that the application is invalid for any reason, then the verifier will provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. The applicant shall be notified of the rejection including the reason for rejection by email. In this case the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. In case the application needs to be amended by the applicant, the verifier can “Reject for amendment” and in this case, the applicant can do necessary changes and re-submit for verification. P05: Recommend for Registration During verification, the verifier finds all provided details are in order, then the verifier can recommend the applicant for Registration as a TSO. In this case System will route the application for review from an Assessor at the Customs Head Officer. If assessor decides to reject the application, then assessor shall provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. System shall notify the applicant on the rejection by email including the reasons of rejection and the status of the application shall be “Rejected”. P06: Register Warehouse Operator During verification, if the Assessor concludes that the provided documents and related details are in order, then the Assessor can approve the application for Registration. In this case, System will register the applicant as a TSO in eCMS. In case fees are applicable and payment is due, the status of the application shall be “Pending Payment”. In case fees are not applicable, the status of the application shall be “Approved”, P07: Send Confirmation Post registration, System will notify the applicant on the successful registration as TSO. If no payments are applicable, then system will send the login credentials and no further processing are required. If payment is applicable, then the applicant shall be notified on the successful completion of review and pending payment status. No login credentials shall be sent in this case. P08: Generate Payment advice Post approval and registration, system will determine if fees are applicable based on configuration. If no fees are applicable, system will allow printing of certificate of registration. If fees are applicable, a payment advice shall be generated and sent to Revenue. Registration certificate printing and login access shall be withheld till all payments are completed. P09: Send to Revenue System eCMS will integrate with Revenue system and send the payment advice generated in previous step. P10: Receive payment confirmation from Revenue System Revenue system will send a payment confirmation to eCMS after collecting payment in Revenue system. After receipt of collection message, eCMS will enable printing of Registration certificate and login access will be restored. P11: Send Login Credentials System will send the login credentials to the applicant. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules The applicant for TSO should have a valid CID, TPN and Trade License A bank guarantee needs to be furnished. However, System will not validate on the authenticity of the bank Guarantee, and this shall be verified by the respective officer. Applicant needs to provide a valid TPN, and system will check for its validity against the PIN Master. Please note that BITS will integrate with eCMS and share Trade license information along with TPN to eCMS. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application Applicant will provide required information and complete all mandatory fields and submit the application. System will check for valid CID and TPN against eCMS PIN Master and will stop the submission if matching CID is not found in the System. Post validation, if all checks pass, System will accept the application for further processing. Note : eCMS will provide an option to register certified declarant (i.e. clearing clerks) as code table entry and system will valid before submitting the application to include declarants under their CFA company. P02: Check Customs Certification The CID of the applicant will be validated by the system with the list of customs certified person, which the system will maintain before the submission of the application. If the CID number cannot be validated, the system should inform the applicant on the same and the system should not allow the applicant to process further with the application. P03: Notify Applicant of Rejection If the application is determined to be unacceptable for any reason, then the Verifier will provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. The applicant shall be notified of the rejection including the reason for rejection by email. P04: Register Declarant If the application is determined to be acceptable by the verifier, the verifier shall approve the application. System will then store the Declarant’s profile in the eCMS database. P05: Send Confirmation System will send a notification to the declarant as per section 1.3 Login Credentials, Password Management Etc. [TABLE] S/N | Additional Features Customs can de-register a declarant anytime if needed and no further integration with BITS is required for this. Once a declarant is de-registered, the declarant cannot access the System anymore. A Declarant can be linked to only one CFA at any given time. In case a declarant moves to another CFA, then the previous CFA must de-register the Declarant. After de-registration, the new CFA needs to register the declarant once again as per the steps mentioned above. System will maintain a history of the various CFA's the declarant has worked for. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules The declarant should have a valid CID. The declarant should not be engaged and active with any other CFA at the point of application. The declarant should be customs certified. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application Trader will provide additional mandatory detail, attach supporting documents, and proceed to submit the application form. System will check for a valid CID and TPN through the following steps. User shall provide the CID/TPN number. The system shall allow the applicant to key in CID as well as TPN. If the applicant keys in the CID, the same should hit the PIN Master, and list all the TPN registered against the CID. If the TPN belongs to a Company, then the Applicant will be required to provide the Company registration number for authentication. System will validate the TPN and provided company registration number combination and, if it matches, proceed to fetch the TPN details and display in the Application. If the information could not be fetched from the Pin Master, the system will provide an option for the user to apply for a fast-track TPN with BITS. After the user applies for fast-track TPN in eCMS, BITS will validate and generate a fast-track TPN and update it back to PIN Master. Refer to Fast-Track TPN process. If the TPN keyed in is valid then System will fetch the related TPN details and display in the application (in case the TPN belongs to a Company, then system will follow authentication using Company registration number as mentioned in Step 3 before displaying TPN details). Applicant can now provide additional details and submit P02: Check Application details When an application has been submitted System will route the application for review by the verifier for verification and approval. P03: Notify Applicant of Rejection During verification, if application details are not found to be in order, then the Verifier will provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. The applicant shall be notified of the rejection including the reason for rejection by email. P04: Register Trader If the application is determined to be valid by the Verifier, the Verifier shall approve the application. System will then register the applicant as a Trader in eCMS. P05: Send confirmation email After approval and registration, System will send a notification to the Trader by email as per section 1.3 Login Credentials, Password Management Etc. [TABLE] S/N | Additional Features In case where a license has been cancelled in PIN Master by BITS through integration, the party should be de-registered in eCMS. This will be done using a batch job. Traders can register any number of users (Citizens) on their own and will manage their own users. Traders can declare only for themselves but not for any other external party. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules The applicant for Trader should have a valid CID/TPN. The Trader cannot apply for the same TPN. System will not allow duplicate applications for the same TPN. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Register User Customs admin will provide necessary information required to register a customs officer including the office to which the user belongs. System will then store the Customs user’s profile in the eCMS database and status of the user shall be set to “Pending Activation.” P02: Assign Roles/Access Rights System will route the approved application to the system admin of the specific RRCO. The system admin will assign role(s) to the applicant which will enable Custom user to perform their assigned duties. system admin can change the access rights of Customs users at any time. The customs officer should be able to access the system once the concerned RRCO assigns the role. The system will maintain the history of the profile even for the ones that have been deregistered. P03: Send Confirmation System will send a notification to the registered Custom user as per section 1.3 Login Credentials, Password Management Etc. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules A custom officer may be registered only once in the System. System will check this through the employee ID of the officer and will not allow duplicate employee ID. [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Register OGA Respective OGA will be required to provide the OGA details along with the admin user details for one time registration by Customs. Customs admin will provide TPN, and other necessary information required to register an OGA and save. System will validate the TPN with eCMS PIN Master and verify provided TPN number. If TPN is in-valid, System will stop the registration with an error message. If TPN is valid, then system will allow Customs admin to register the OGA. Customs admin will then provide required information to register an OGA, assign roles to the OGA and submit. System will validate and register the OGA in eCMS. P02: Send Confirmation System will send a notification to the registered OGA admin user as per section 1.3 Login Credentials, Password Management Etc. P03: Register OGA users by OGA Admin Respective OGA admin can register their own OGA users and assign roles which shall be restricted to the roles assigned by Customs to the OGA during registration. Registered OGA user shall receive email notification on registration just like any other normal user. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules OGA TPN should be valid and available in the System OGA Admin user should have a valid CID. An OGA can be registered only once (No duplication) [TABLE] Process Steps P01: Submit Application eCMS system will send periodic notifications to the Company admins of parties requiring renewal of Clearing and Forwarding Agents and Warehouse Operators. Company admin will login to eCMS and prepare and submit a renewal application like what was used for registering the entity. The status of the renewal application shall be “Pending Review.” P02: Review Renewal Application After the application has been submitted, System will route the application for review from a Verifier at the Customs Head Office. P03: Notify Applicant of Rejection During verification, if any of the application details are not found to be in order, then the Verifier will provide reasons for rejection and reject the application. The applicant shall be notified of the rejection including the reason for rejection by email. P04: Send confirmation email If the application is approved by the Verifier, then System will send an approval email to the Company admin. [TABLE] S/N | Validation Rules Only one renewal request can be submitted at one time for any given party.

[GENERAL] SRS_eCMS_Report_Part I_Final

## General Release No 1.0 – Sept 2021 ## Endorsement by System Owner (internal) release history ## Table of Contents 1. Table of Contents 2 2. Introduction 4 2.1 References 4 2.2 Definitions and Abbreviations 4 3. Functional Requirements 5 3.1 OPERATIONAL Report OVERVIEW 5 3.2 Pre-Requisites and Assumptions 5 3.3 Operational report process flow 5 3.4 Use case diagram for Operational report 6 4. Operational Reports List 7 4.1 Number of applications Submitted 8 4.2 Number of Registration Submitted 8 4.3 Number of Manifest submitted 8 4.4 Summary of Declaration types submitted to customs 8 4.5 Total number of employees(user) 9 4.6 Total amount paid by tax types 9 4.7 Number of declarations made by a particular clearing agent 9 4.8 Expenses incurred to clear the goods from Kolkata 9 4.9 Details of goods cleared and dispatched from LTO. 10 4.10 Temporary Admission reconciliation report 10 4.11 Re-export reconciliation report 10 4.12 Bonded warehouse reconciliation report 11 4.13 warehouse reconciliation report 11 4.14 Refund Exemption Reconciliation Report 12 4.15 Total Number of Duty-Free Quota issued 13 4.16 Total number of customs officers by region and check post 13 4.17 summary of General exemptions 13 4.18 Number of Transactions under Authorized Compliant Trader (ACT) 13 4.19 Details of Goods stored in Each Warehouse 14 4.20 Details of Goods stored in the Temporary Storage 14 4.21 Number of Detention/Seizure/Confiscation (OFFENCE) 15 ## Introduction This document defines & illustrates the Reports requirements, process flows as well as the detailed requirements of eCMS Operational Report module to be implemented for Department of Revenue and Customs, Bhutan. ## References The creation of the BECMS SRS was referenced using the following documents: ## FUNCATIONAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION.docx ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-3.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-4.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-5B.pdf ## Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6A.pdf Bhutan eCMS Technical Proposal TECH-6B.pdf ## Definitions and Abbreviations The table below lists the different acronyms and abbreviations as well as the definitions used throughout this SRS. ## Functional Requirements OPERATIONAL Report OVERVIEW Operational reporting is the process of regularly providing the complete report of an organization’s day to day activities and operations. These reports provide operational insights for time intervals like hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly. Serving various functions, these reports at times need to be customized for specific insights. The operational reports will help the manger in identifying the areas that need attention and the ones that need to be tracked regularly. ## Pre-Requisites and Assumptions User should have valid credential and able to access the Report in eCMS Operational report can be designed using the Jasper Report. Operational Reports date range should be less than or equal to 3 months of data. ## Operational report can send to the preview to see how the reports can looks when printed User should have able to download the report to pdf or excel format depend on user requirement. All the values and amounts in reports should be in NU. Input parameter of the start date and end date, by default is selected as current date. Others input parameter can be selected as all or particulars depend on user need. All financial data will be held in a minimum of 10.2(10 digit and 2 decimal digits) format or greater in alignment with international standard. ## Operational report process flow Use case diagram for Operational report ## Operational Reports List Following are the list of Operational Reports. ## Number of applications Submitted Input Parameters: Start Date: and End Date, Type of applications ## Note: parameter application types (particular or all option) Number of Registration Submitted ## Input Parameters: Start Date: and End Date, Type of Registrations: Note: parameter should be Registration type (particular or all option) ## Number of Manifest submitted Input Parameter: -Start Date to end date, Type of Manifest: ## Note: parameter manifest types (particular or all option) Summary of Declaration types submitted to customs ## Input Parameter: -Start Date to end date, Types of Declaration: Note: parameter declaration types (particular or all option) ## Total number of employees(user) Input parameter Start Date to end date, Types of Registered user ## Note: parameter should be Register user types (particular or all option) Total amount paid by tax types ## Input Parameter Start Date to end date, Customs office: Note: parameter custom office(particular), check post (particular or all option) ## Number of declarations made by a particular clearing agent Input parameter Start Date to end date, Name of CFA /TPN of CFA: ## Note: parameter Name of CFA & TPN of CFA (particular). The purpose of dynamic reports is to allow users to independently conduct deeper mining and custom reports on demand based on the extracted XLS values. In addition, the end-user can also export into PDF or Excel without asking help from the developers from the available data mart. Dynamic Reports generated from the data mart, which is consist of data mart of a particular business process Examples, like Details of Import and export Transactions. ## Pre-Requisites and Assumptions User should have valid credential and able to access the Dynamic report User can access the report base on their roles assigned by super admin. Dynamic Report can be design using Agreed Report Designer example Pentaho or Power BI. Dynamic Reports can be managed using specified date range. ## We always recommend extracting with shorter duration for the better performance User should have option extracting the report either PDF or Excel format depend on user’s requirement. All financial data will be held in a minimum of 10.2 (10 digit and 2 decimal digits) format or greater in alignment with international standard. ## Dynamic Report Architecture Data sources: eCMS transactional details are the primary sources of the Data marts to eCMS fact tables. eCMS Data marts: eCMS Data Marts contain repositories of summarized data collected for the analysis on a specific unit for the report. We can use ETL (Extract, Transfer and Load) process to load the data from data sources (transactional database) to the specifies Fact table. So, Fact table can store the cleans analysis data for the analytic. Presentation Stage: In Analytic stage we can use Statistics, analyzing and interpreting BI server to analysis data to assess quality and meaningful for reporting and reorganizing data in a readable format. End User: After data analysis user can get access and view the data in the form of dashboard. In this stage the register user can also export into PDF or Excel reports. ## Process flow for Dynamic report Use case for Dynamic report ## Dynamic Reports Fact transaction mapping table Dynamic Report Fact Transaction Mapping Table contain main dynamic report data and this data comprises of the estimation measurement or actualities of the dynamic report mapping procedure and it can help to ## General Release No 1.0 – Jul 2021 ## Endorsement by System Owner (internal) release history ## Table of Contents Table of Contents 3 ## Introduction 4 A. Definitions and Abbreviations 4 ## B.
